name: Ancestral Advisor
body:
School: necromancy; Level: cleric 2, inquisitor 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You summon an ancestral spirit to help you accomplish a task.

You gain a +10 competence bonus to a specific skill which lasts for the duration of the spell. Furthermore, you are considered trained in the chosen skill. Only one ancestral advisor can aid you at a time. A spell that wards against spirits effectively suppresses this spell until the target is outside the warded area.
